## Due Diligence

- [ ] If needed, open an [Accessibility review](https://github.com/github/accessibility/issues/) - they have office hours every 2nd Tuesday.
- [ ] Open a [Security Review](https://github.com/github/security-reviews/issues/new?assignees=octocat&labels=calculate-risk&template=security_review_request.yaml&title=%5BSecurity-Review%5D%3A+) - also consider whether a privacy review might be needed.
- [ ] Consult the [Product Engineering Playbook](https://github.com/github/product-engineering/blob/master/playbook.md) for application engineering considerations that may apply to your project.
